description: a bar of radius 1.43 on z less a ball of radius 2 centred (0.39, 0.78, 1.48): the ball's section with the bar's wall leaves the top cap where the two walls meet at about 5°. Found at a random pose in two hundred (plans/c3-conic-hits step 5).
